$comment: What may be said about Kleidos, each value one a public page already states or the owner has given for publication (its source then says so). A value that ages carries as_of. The texts under about/ and press-kit/ are held to this file by tools/check.py.

name.rule: A capital K and nothing else in capitals.
name.exceptions: The address kleidos.dev and the names of files and repositories are lower case.

origin.en: From the Ancient Greek κλειδός (kleidós), "of the key", the genitive of κλείς (kleís), key: a name meant to be pronounceable in any language and to say what the project is.
origin.es: Del griego antiguo κλειδός (kleidós), «de la llave», genitivo de κλείς (kleís), «llave»: un nombre pensado para pronunciarse en cualquier idioma y para decir qué es el proyecto.
origin.source: The owner's account, 2026-11-17: a name pronounceable in any language that says what the project is, derived from Greek.

pronunciation.source: The owner, 2026-11-17: two syllables, the stress on the e of the diphthong ei.
pronunciation.en: KLAY-dos (/ˈklei̯.dos/): two syllables, the stress on the first. It is the project's own pronunciation; the Ancient Greek genitive, kleidós, stresses the last syllable.
pronunciation.es: «kléi-dos» (/ˈklei̯.dos/): dos sílabas, con el acento en la primera. Es la pronunciación propia del proyecto; el genitivo del griego antiguo, kleidós, lleva el acento en la última.
pronunciation.$note: Confirmed, so each name-and-history page and each fact sheet prints the guide of its language and the IPA; while confirmed is false, no text prints either (tools/check.py).

former.en: The name the project was going to carry while it was meant only for the M5Stick boards.
former.es: El nombre que iba a llevar el proyecto mientras estaba pensado solo para las placas M5Stick.

history.$note: Each event's said phrase is the one every history text writes; tools/check.py holds name-and-history.md and the fact sheet to it.

events.en: First attempts; the project is started and set aside more than once in the years that follow.
events.es: Primeros intentos; el proyecto se empieza y se aparca más de una vez en los años siguientes.

events.en: Still in development and not released: the firmware has to be solid before it is offered to the community.
events.es: Sigue en desarrollo y sin publicar: el firmware tiene que ser sólido antes de ofrecérselo a la comunidad.

kind.en: free firmware that turns a small ESP32 board into a hardware password manager
kind.es: un firmware libre y gratuito que convierte una pequeña placa ESP32 en un gestor de contraseñas por hardware

license.name: GNU General Public License, version 3 or any later version
license.source: private until the repository is opened, a step on the roadmap

price: Nothing to pay the project and no account to open; you buy the board from whoever sells it.

independent.en: Kleidos is an independent project, not affiliated with M5Stack or LILYGO. Product names are their owners' trademarks.
independent.es: Kleidos es un proyecto independiente, sin vinculación con M5Stack ni con LILYGO. Los nombres de producto son marcas de sus propietarios.

status.en: In development. Not released: there is nothing to download yet.
status.es: En desarrollo. Sin publicar: todavía no hay nada que descargar.

link.en: A Bluetooth LE keyboard: it sends keystrokes and reads nothing
link.es: Un teclado Bluetooth LE: envía pulsaciones y no lee nada

encryption.en: AES-256-CBC + HMAC-SHA256, its key derived from your PIN or passphrase by PBKDF2-SHA256
encryption.es: AES-256-CBC + HMAC-SHA256, con la clave derivada de tu PIN o tu contraseña de desbloqueo mediante PBKDF2-SHA256

capacity.en: 90 to 500 credentials and 30 to 50 two-factor (TOTP) codes, depending on the board
capacity.es: De 90 a 500 credenciales y de 30 a 50 códigos 2FA (TOTP), según la placa

en: Not released: there is nothing to download or install yet (as of 2026-11-17).
Not a product you buy: it is firmware for a board you buy from whoever sells it. The project sells nothing.
Not a FIDO2 or U2F security key: it is a password manager, and it does no FIDO2, U2F, PIV or OpenPGP.
Not made, sponsored or endorsed by M5Stack or LILYGO.
Not a keylogger and not a keyboard you type on: it sends keystrokes and reads nothing.
es: No está publicado: todavía no hay nada que descargar ni instalar (a 17 de noviembre de 2026).
No es un producto que compres: es un firmware para una placa que compras a quien la venda. El proyecto no vende nada.
No es una llave de seguridad FIDO2 ni U2F: es un gestor de contraseñas, y no implementa FIDO2, U2F, PIV ni OpenPGP.
No lo fabrican, patrocinan ni avalan M5Stack ni LILYGO.
No registra pulsaciones ni es un teclado en el que escribas: envía pulsaciones y no lee nada.
No lo ha auditado nadie independiente.
